'''Harrigan Shunt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as Head [[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] army's heavy artillery division. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Shunt was arrested by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and then imprisoned within [[The Prism]] throughout the rest of the war. After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the subsequent [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis coup]], Shunt was released and became part of a [[Mission to the Prism|brutal test]] created by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, to see who among the prisoners was worthy of joining the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Shunt was among a number of failed prisoners that were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the brutal battle.
